boards.title: Your First Weekend at Mercer University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented to Mercer’s Macon campus, connecting with campus life, and adding a documented local cultural stop.

cards.title: Start with the Admissions and Welcome Center
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival • Macon campus orientation
cards.notes: Use the map-listed Welcome Center as your first landmark, then orient yourself to nearby Cruz Plaza and the main academic side of campus.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a named campus arrival point before choosing the rest of your route.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer’s current Macon campus map identifies an Admissions and Welcome Center near Cruz Plaza.
cards.access_notes: Confirm visitor services and access arrangements directly with Mercer before arrival.

cards.title: Meet Jesse Mercer in the Quadrangle
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Jesse Mercer Plaza
cards.notes: Pause at the map-listed statue and read the surrounding setting; save the documented head-rub tradition for its official convocation context.
cards.short_summary: A distinctive campus landmark tied to Mercer’s first-year and graduation ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer documents that first-year students process past the Jesse Mercer statue during Fall Convocation and graduating seniors during Baccalaureate.
cards.access_notes: The statue is identified on Mercer’s Macon campus map; observe any event setup or campus-use guidance.

cards.title: Find Jack Tarver Library before classes start
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Academic core
cards.notes: Locate the map-listed library, note its entrances and nearby paths, and make it your reference point for returning to the academic core.
cards.short_summary: A practical map-and-routine stop before the first full week of classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer’s current Macon campus map labels the Library among the central campus destinations.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s own site for current building access and service hours.

cards.title: Use the Bear Statue as a campus marker
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Near the University Center
cards.notes: Add the map-listed Bear Statue to your walking loop, then use it to connect the University Center, science buildings, and nearby campus routes.
cards.short_summary: A named visual landmark that helps stitch together the central campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer’s current Macon campus map labels a Bear Statue near the University Center and Godsey Science Center.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; follow posted campus guidance and accessible-route information.

cards.title: Get your bearings at the University Center
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • Recreation and campus gathering
cards.notes: Walk through the University Center to identify the recreation, intramural, wellness, and athletics spaces gathered in one named campus building.
cards.short_summary: A central place to understand several everyday Mercer activities at once.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer says the University Center brings students together for recreational, intramural, wellness, and athletic activities.
cards.access_notes: Building and program access may depend on Mercer affiliation and scheduled events.

cards.title: Plan a meal at Fresh Food Company
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • Campus dining
cards.notes: Check your meal membership and use the listed Fresh Food Company location for a straightforward first campus meal before settling into the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A current Macon meal-plan dining location for building an easy routine.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer’s Macon meal-membership page lists Fresh Food Company as a location where meal swipes may be used.
cards.access_notes: A meal membership or other payment may be required; verify current dining operations before going.

cards.title: Try a fitness-center orientation
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • University Center
cards.notes: If you have appropriate access, take a brief orientation lap through the Fitness Center and identify equipment or programs you may want to revisit.
cards.short_summary: A daytime activity option inside Mercer’s University Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer identifies a Fitness Center within the University Center and describes it as offering a variety of workout options.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current eligibility, check-in requirements, and operating hours with the University Center.

cards.title: Put Bear Fair on your first-week calendar
cards.subtitle: Monday after the weekend • University Center
cards.notes: After the weekend, visit Bear Fair to compare campus organizations and Central Georgia connections, then follow up with the groups that fit your interests.
cards.short_summary: A documented annual introduction to campus organizations and the surrounding area.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer describes Bear Fair as an annual University Center event that introduces new Mercerians to campus organizations and Central Georgia.
cards.access_notes: Mercer lists Bear Fair as occurring the Monday before fall classes in August; confirm the year’s details before attending.

cards.title: Check the calendar at Five Star Stadium
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening option • Mercer athletics
cards.notes: If a home date aligns with your weekend, use the official schedule to plan a stadium visit and confirm ticketing, parking, and game-day details.
cards.short_summary: A named on-campus athletics destination with a current published football schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercer Athletics lists 2026 home football games at Five Star Stadium in Macon, including the August 29 game versus East Texas A&M.
cards.access_notes: Event attendance requires the applicable ticket and event policies; scheduled times are subject to change.

cards.title: Make a daytime visit to Ocmulgee Mounds
cards.subtitle: Sunday daytime • Macon cultural stop
cards.notes: Plan a daytime cultural stop around the Earth Lodge and Great Temple Mound, using the park’s official directions, safety guidance, and operating information.
cards.short_summary: A documented Macon historic landscape with several named visitor features.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service identifies the Earth Lodge and Great Temple Mound among the visitor features at Ocmulgee Mounds National Historical Park.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit: Ocmulgee Mounds National Historical Park
cards.access_notes: NPS states grounds are generally open 8 a.m.–5 p.m., except specified federal holidays; verify conditions before travel.
